name: edge
description: EDGEchat: Cyberpunk 2077 modding with the EDGE tools: modding knowledge as skills, the REDnode, REDcode, EDGEdeck, EDGEmat, EDGEfab, EDGEhack and EDGEquest MCP servers, and modding commands.

game_path.title: Cyberpunk 2077 folder
game_path.description: The game's install folder (it holds archive, bin and r6). Leave empty if REDcode is set up in VS Code: redcode-mcp then reads REDcode's setting.

redbridge_exe.title: REDbridge.exe
redbridge_exe.description: REDbridge, which reads the game's files: REDbridge-<version>-win-x64.zip from github.com/Edgemodders/REDbridge/releases, unzipped anywhere (it needs the .NET 10 runtime). Leave empty if REDcode is set up in VS Code: the servers then read REDcode's setting.

edgedeck_library.title: EDGEdeck library
edgedeck_library.description: EDGEdeck's mod library folder. Leave empty for the default, the EDGEdeck folder in your user folder. Set it only if you changed EDGEdeck's Library Path setting in VS Code.

gemini_api_key.title: Google Gemini API key
gemini_api_key.description: For EDGEmat's materials from words (mat_generate) and patterns, billed to your Google account. From aistudio.google.com > Get API key. Leave empty if it is set in REDcode's Keys (shared by the EDGE tools), or you do not use it.

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key
openai_api_key.description: For EDGEmat's materials from words and reshapes, and EDGEfab's pictures, billed to your OpenAI account. From platform.openai.com > API keys. Leave empty if it is set in REDcode's Keys, or you do not use it. If both Gemini and OpenAI are set, EDGEmat uses Gemini unless you ask for OpenAI.

tripo_api_key.title: Tripo API key
tripo_api_key.description: For EDGEfab's 3D models from words or pictures and EDGEmat's reshapes, billed in Tripo credits. From platform.tripo3d.ai. Leave empty if it is set in REDcode's Keys, or you only bring models of your own.
